name: Payoff letter
what: A lender's or lienholder's statement of the amount needed to release its lien on a date.

fields.label: Lienholder
fields.definition: The lender or lienholder issuing the letter, the servicer if different, and a contact who can update the figures.

fields.label: Borrower
fields.definition: The borrower or debtor the letter names, which should be the seller or its entity.

fields.label: Lien being paid
fields.definition: The deed of trust or other lien the payment releases, with its recording data, so the release can be matched to the instrument of record.

fields.label: Good through
fields.definition: The last date on which the stated total pays the debt in full.

fields.label: Principal balance
fields.definition: Unpaid principal as of the letter.

fields.label: Accrued interest
fields.definition: Interest accrued through the good-through date, and the rate it accrues at.

fields.label: Per diem interest
fields.definition: Interest added for each day after the good-through date, used to update the total if funding slips.

fields.label: Prepayment cost
fields.definition: Any prepayment premium, yield maintenance, defeasance cost or swap breakage included, with how the letter computes it.

fields.label: Fees and charges
fields.definition: Late charges, default interest, legal fees, release and recording fees and any other item, each with its amount, to compare with what the loan documents allow.

fields.label: Reserve and escrow balances
fields.definition: Reserve and escrow balances the lender holds, and whether they are netted against the payoff or refunded after it.

fields.label: Total payoff
fields.definition: The total needed on the good-through date to pay the debt and release the lien.

fields.label: Release commitment
fields.definition: What the lender says it will deliver once paid, such as a recordable release of the deed of trust and termination of financing statements, and by when.

fields.label: Wire verification
fields.definition: Where the lender's wire instructions are stored and how and when they were confirmed by a call to a number from an independent source. Never the account or routing number.

fields.label: Conditions on the figures
fields.definition: Conditions the letter places on its figures, such as no further advances or returned payments, or an expiry if the funds do not arrive.
